slides.title: Introduction to Forms
slides.content:
# Django Forms 📋

Forms handle user input, validation, and data processing!

## What you'll learn:
- **Form Classes** - Define form structure
- **Rendering Forms** - Display in templates
- **Validation** - Built-in and custom
- **ModelForms** - Forms from models

## Why Django Forms?

```python
# Without Django forms (manual)
def contact(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        name = request.POST.get('name', '')
        if not name:  # Manual validation
            error = 'Name is required'
        # ... more validation

# With Django forms (automatic)
def contact(request):
    form = ContactForm(request.POST or None)
    if form.is_valid():  # All validation done!
        data = form.cleaned_data
```

> 💡 **Django Forms handle validation, security (CSRF), and rendering automatically!**

slides.title: Creating Forms
slides.content:
# Form Classes 📝

## Basic Form

```python
# forms.py
from django import forms

class ContactForm(forms.Form):
    name = forms.CharField(max_length=100)
    email = forms.EmailField()
    message = forms.CharField(widget=forms.Textarea)
    subscribe = forms.BooleanField(required=False)
```

## Common Field Types

| Field | HTML Input |
|-------|------------|
| `CharField` | Text input |
| `EmailField` | Email input |
| `IntegerField` | Number input |
| `BooleanField` | Checkbox |
| `ChoiceField` | Select dropdown |
| `DateField` | Date input |
| `FileField` | File upload |

## Field Options

```python
name = forms.CharField(
    max_length=100,
    required=True,           # Required by default
    label='Your Name',       # Custom label
    initial='John',          # Default value
    help_text='Enter name',  # Help text
    widget=forms.TextInput(  # Custom widget
        attrs={'class': 'form-control', 'placeholder': 'Name'}
    )
)
```
